scope: Automated real-browser checks with real API/PostgreSQL. New isolated synthetic demo runs; shared C7D0B82B checked read-only. No external email or independent human pilot.
root_cause: A retained candidate view could send requests with an employer cookie after another tab changed login. Public history/availability requests returned 403; reproduced in two tabs sharing cookies.
fix: Shared session transition for login/restoration; revalidate on focus, pageshow, visibility, storage and rejected API requests; reject stale-account reads/writes before execution; ignore old responses. Independently load history and availability, bound requests to 15 seconds and allow manual abort/retry.

repeatability: Two runs have the same initial grade, publication, scores, question counts and empty conversations/tasks. IDs, times and generated question values deliberately differ. Rejoining the same run preserves its changes; a new run restores the baseline without resetting others.
restoration_test_scope: Real saved cookies in fresh contexts and reloads; pageshow(persisted=true) dispatched to exercise the restored-page handler. No claim of forcing a particular browser BFCache implementation.
